node.title: Re^3: Dereferencing in blessed object
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The main script has use strict; but it seems that does then apply to the module it calls...I know that now!

The scope of [doc://strict] and many other pragmas like [doc://warnings] is lexical: if you put it at the top of a file, its scope is only that file, and does not extend to any files included with [doc://do], [doc://require], or [doc://use].

But - I feel sure there is a more elegant way!

Though I concur with [hippo] that braces are easiest here, in the spirit of TIMTOWTDI note there's also the /e modifier: $db =~ s/_.+?_/"_$dbname"."_"/e;
